CLINICAL FEATURES OF ECLAMPSIA
Clinical Features
- Generalized tonic-clonic seizures, usually heralded by:
- Headaches
- Dizziness and blurring of vision
- Nausea and vomiting
- Epigastric pain
- Rapidly progressive oedema.
- Exaggerated tendon reflexes.
- Oliguria
- Hypertension.
- Worsening proteinuria
